dimensions.name: Governance Awareness
dimensions.rationale: The rules context loader and alignment engine successfully executed and validated against their respective schemas, demonstrating governance structure retention despite upstream failures.

dimensions.name: Causal Reasoning Depth
dimensions.rationale: Key synthesis stages including the evolution map and architecture intent generation completed with valid schema outputs, though missing context from the failed conversation-to-aw step attenuated end-to-end causal linkage.

dimensions.name: Architectural Tension Analysis
dimensions.rationale: Alignment evaluation succeeded in resolving trade-offs down the pipeline, but the failure of forensic reconciliation and conversation extraction limited the depth of surfaced tensions.
